trait.name: Warded Kit
entries: The constable-adept has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects while it is wearing its marshal's sigil.

spellcasting.name: Rune Training
headerEntries: The constable-adept carries a set of trained runes. Its spellcasting ability is Intelligence (spell save {@dc 12}, {@hit 4} to hit with spell attacks).

action.name: Baton
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 3} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}4 ({@damage 1d6 + 1}) bludgeoning damage.

action.name: Binding Rune (2/Day)
entries: The constable-adept throws a rune-scribed cord at one creature it can see within 30 feet. The target must succeed on a {@dc 12} Dexterity saving throw or be {@condition restrained} for 1 minute. The target can use its action to make a {@dc 12} Strength check, freeing itself on a success.
The street level of the Arcane Marshals. Trained on a handful of runes, issued a baton, and expected to write everything down.

trait.name: Warded Kit
entries: The sergeant-adept has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

trait.name: Squad Discipline
entries: Allied Marshals within 30 feet that can see the sergeant-adept add 1 to their AC.

spellcasting.name: Spellcasting
headerEntries: The sergeant-adept is a 5th-level spellcaster. Its spellcasting ability is Intelligence (spell save {@dc 13}, {@hit 5} to hit with spell attacks). It has the following spells prepared:

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The sergeant-adept makes two attacks with its baton, or casts a spell and makes one attack.

action.name: Rune-Etched Baton
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 4} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}5 ({@damage 1d6 + 2}) bludgeoning damage plus 3 ({@damage 1d6}) force damage.

action.name: Binding Rune (3/Day)
entries: One creature the sergeant-adept can see within 30 feet must succeed on a {@dc 13} Dexterity saving throw or be {@condition restrained} for 1 minute. The target can use its action to make a {@dc 13} Strength check, freeing itself on a success.

reaction.name: Ward Ally
entries: When a creature the sergeant-adept can see within 30 feet is hit by an attack, the sergeant-adept adds 3 to that creature's AC against the attack, possibly causing it to miss.
Leads a hand of constables and carries the warrants. The rank where the job stops being paperwork and starts being decisions.

trait.name: Warded Kit
entries: The lieutenant has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

trait.name: Reads the Scene
entries: The lieutenant has advantage on Intelligence ({@skill Investigation}) checks made to reconstruct what happened in a place within the last 24 hours.

trait.name: Hold the Line
entries: Allied Marshals within 30 feet that can see the lieutenant add 1 to their AC and to their saving throws.

spellcasting.name: Spellcasting
headerEntries: The lieutenant is a 8th-level spellcaster. Its spellcasting ability is Intelligence (spell save {@dc 15}, {@hit 7} to hit with spell attacks). It has the following spells prepared:

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The lieutenant makes two attacks with its baton, or casts a spell and makes one attack.

action.name: Rune-Etched Baton
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 5} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}6 ({@damage 1d6 + 2}) bludgeoning damage plus 7 ({@damage 2d6}) force damage.

action.name: Writ of Restraint (Recharge 5-6)
entries: The lieutenant names one creature it can see within 60 feet and speaks the terms of its warrant. The target must succeed on a {@dc 15} Wisdom saving throw or be {@condition restrained} by bands of light for 1 minute. The target repeats the save at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on a success. While restrained this way the target's spellcasting requires a successful {@dc 15} Constitution check.

reaction.name: Counter
entries: When a creature the lieutenant can see within 60 feet casts a spell of 3rd level or lower, the lieutenant can expend a spell slot of 3rd level or higher to cast {@spell counterspell} in response.
The rank that runs an investigation end to end and signs for it. Fights carefully, arrests by preference, and does not chase.

trait.name: Impartial Spine
entries: Elowen has advantage on saving throws against being {@condition charmed} or {@condition frightened}, and against any magic that would compel him to speak or act falsely.

trait.name: Warded Office
entries: Elowen has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

trait.name: States the Facts
entries: Elowen has advantage on Wisdom ({@skill Insight}) checks, and he automatically knows when a creature he can hear tells him a deliberate lie unless that creature succeeds on a {@dc 16} Charisma ({@skill Deception}) check.

trait.name: Presides
entries: Allied Marshals within 60 feet that can see Elowen add 2 to their AC and to their saving throws.

spellcasting.name: Spellcasting
headerEntries: Elowen is a 12th-level spellcaster. Its spellcasting ability is Intelligence (spell save {@dc 16}, {@hit 8} to hit with spell attacks). It has the following spells prepared:

action.name: Multiattack
entries: Elowen makes three attacks with his baton, or casts a spell and makes one attack.

action.name: Captain's Baton
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 8} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}8 ({@damage 1d8 + 4}) bludgeoning damage plus 10 ({@damage 3d6}) force damage.

action.name: Writ of Restraint (Recharge 5-6)
entries: Elowen names one creature he can see within 60 feet. The target must succeed on a {@dc 16} Wisdom saving throw or be {@condition restrained} by bands of light for 1 minute. The target repeats the save at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on a success. While restrained this way its spellcasting requires a successful {@dc 16} Constitution check.

action.name: Clear the Ring (1/Day)
entries: Elowen strikes his baton on the ground. Every creature of his choice within 30 feet must make a {@dc 16} Strength saving throw. On a failure a creature takes 21 ({@damage 6d6}) force damage and is pushed 20 feet away and knocked {@condition prone}. On a success it takes half damage and is not moved. Ongoing spells of 3rd level or lower in the area end.

reaction.name: Counter
entries: When a creature Elowen can see within 60 feet casts a spell of 4th level or lower, he can expend a spell slot of 4th level or higher to cast {@spell counterspell} in response.

reaction.name: Interpose Ward
entries: When a creature Elowen can see within 30 feet is hit by an attack, he adds 5 to that creature's AC against the attack, possibly causing it to miss.
Captain of the Arcane Marshals, appointed for life by the vassal houses, which is the whole of his power and the whole of his cage.

Flat, procedural, unhurried. He states facts and then waits. Under pressure he gets colder and more precise, and stops explaining himself entirely. He does not raise his voice and does not repeat himself.

trait.name: Gnome Cunning
entries: Alma has advantage on Intelligence, Wisdom, and Charisma saving throws against magic.

trait.name: She Has Been Warned
entries: Alma does not cooperate with a rescue on sight. On the first round of contact she resists: she pulls her son away, refuses to move, or raises her voice. This is cleared instantly by Pell's proof-word, or by {@spell calm emotions}, {@spell charm person}, or {@spell sanctuary} cast on her, or by a successful {@dc 14} Charisma ({@skill Persuasion}) check that costs an action. Until it clears, moving her requires a grapple, and grappling her advances the Alarm Clock one tick.

trait.name: A Month of Counting
entries: Alma knows the crew rotation, the shift change, which bravo unbars the cellar hatch, and that another family was held in the back room before hers.

trait.name: Apron Pockets
entries: Alma carries four torn pages out of Nessa Ruhl's ledger. She hands them over once she trusts whoever has her, and not a moment earlier.

action.name: Improvised Weapon (Laundry Iron, Kettle, Chair)
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 1} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}2 ({@damage 1d4}) bludgeoning damage. She will use it, but only between a Pyreborn and her son.
Pell Marrow's wife, a gnome laundress, held at the Drover's Rest with their nine-year-old son Denn.
Under fire she does not flee. She covers Denn with her body and stays put, which means the party is fighting around a prone civilian and a child. That is the intended pressure.

trait.name: Chest-Sick
entries: Nine years old and a month in a root cellar. Denn has disadvantage on ability checks from fever, and he can't move more than 60 feet without stopping to catch his breath. Carrying him is the practical answer, and it costs a rescuer a free hand.

trait.name: The Cough
entries: Audible through the floorboards at up to 30 feet in a quiet house. It is how the party finds the back room, and later the cellar hatch.
He is a clock, not a combatant. Every round he is still in the building is a round the scene is not over.

trait.name: Mob Courage
entries: The rioter has advantage on saving throws against being {@condition frightened} while at least three other rioters are within 30 feet of it. If the number of rioters within 30 feet drops below three, the rioter must succeed on a {@dc 10} Wisdom saving throw at the end of its turn or flee.

action.name: Improvised Weapon
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 3} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}4 ({@damage 1d6 + 1}) bludgeoning damage.

action.name: Thrown Stone
entries: {@atk rw} {@hit 2} to hit, range 20/60 ft., one target. {@h}2 ({@damage 1d4}) bludgeoning damage.
Not a soldier and not a criminal. Someone who has had enough, in a crowd that has had enough, holding whatever was to hand.
Rioters break as a group. Give the crowd one reason to disperse and the fight can end without a body.

trait.name: Frontier Veteran
entries: Corvane has advantage on Initiative rolls and on saving throws against being {@condition frightened}. He cannot be surprised while conscious.

trait.name: Political Shark
entries: Corvane has advantage on Charisma checks made against a creature whose weakness, debts, or family he knows, and he usually knows.

trait.name: Brute
entries: A melee weapon deals one extra die of its damage when Corvane hits with it (included below).

trait.name: Nothing Left to Lose but One Thing
entries: While a creature Corvane regards as his heir is {@condition incapacitated} or in danger and within his sight, Corvane makes all attack rolls with advantage and has resistance to all damage.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: Corvane makes three attacks with his warhammer.

action.name: Crested Warhammer
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 8} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}13 ({@damage 2d8 + 4}) bludgeoning damage, and the target must succeed on a {@dc 16} Strength saving throw or be pushed 5 feet and have disadvantage on its next attack roll.

action.name: Shield Bash
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 8} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}8 ({@damage 1d6 + 4}) bludgeoning damage, and the target must succeed on a {@dc 16} Strength saving throw or be knocked {@condition prone}.

action.name: A Word to the Wise (Recharge 5-6)
entries: Corvane speaks, low and level, to one creature he can see within 60 feet that can understand him. The target must succeed on a {@dc 15} Wisdom saving throw or be {@condition frightened} of him for 1 minute, repeating the save at the end of each of its turns. A creature that has seen Corvane kill someone makes this save with disadvantage.

bonus.name: Send Them
entries: One ally within 60 feet that can see or hear Corvane uses its reaction to move up to its speed and make one weapon attack.

reaction.name: Old Reflex
entries: When Corvane is hit by a melee attack, he can make one attack with his warhammer against the attacker.

reaction.name: Nothing Touches the Boy
entries: When an ally within 10 feet of Corvane would take damage, Corvane can take that damage instead.
Won his family into nobility a generation ago on the frontier, and has spent the years since learning that words work faster than an axe.
Gravelly, deep, deliberate. Goes from serious to yelling in about three seconds. Reaches for violence last and is entirely willing to reach for it.
His fear is dying without an heir. Threaten his son and the politician stops being in the room.

trait.name: Crowd Favourite
entries: While at least five creatures who are not hostile to him can see him, Cassian has advantage on Charisma checks and gains 5 temporary hit points at the start of each of his turns.

trait.name: Runecraft Brawler
entries: Cassian's unarmed strikes are magical and deal fire damage as shown below. He adds his Charisma modifier to their damage rolls.

trait.name: Will Not Back Down
entries: When Cassian is reduced to half his hit points or fewer, he adds 2 to his attack rolls and ignores the {@condition frightened} condition until the end of the fight.

trait.name: Showman's Footwork
entries: Opportunity attacks against Cassian are made with disadvantage.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: Cassian makes three unarmed strikes.

action.name: Rune-Burning Fist
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 7} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}7 ({@damage 1d6 + 4}) bludgeoning damage plus 7 ({@damage 2d6}) fire damage.

action.name: Ignition (Recharge 5-6)
entries: Cassian slams both fists together and releases the stored charge in a 15-foot cone. Each creature in the area must make a {@dc 15} Dexterity saving throw, taking 21 ({@damage 6d6}) fire damage on a failed save, or half as much on a successful one.

bonus.name: Step Up
entries: Cassian moves up to half his speed toward a creature that damaged him since the end of his last turn, without provoking opportunity attacks.

reaction.name: Is That All You've Got
entries: When Cassian takes damage from an attack he can see, he reduces the damage by 5 ({@dice 1d10}) and his next attack roll this round is made with advantage.
Nineteen, gifted, and completely certain he belongs at the top. A mageraft brawler the old houses cannot stand and the crowd cannot get enough of.
He fights forward and he does not disengage. Backed into a corner he pushes harder, because the alternative is finding out whether the hype is true.

trait.name: Feline Agility
entries: When Eclair moves on her turn in combat, she can double her speed until the end of the turn. She cannot use this trait again until she moves 0 feet on one of her turns.

trait.name: Duelist's Discipline
entries: Eclair adds 3 to her AC against the first attack made against her each round (included above) while she is wielding a finesse weapon and no shield.

trait.name: Earned It
entries: Eclair has advantage on saving throws against being {@condition charmed} or {@condition frightened}, and on ability checks made to resist being talked out of a course of action.

trait.name: Sure-Footed
entries: Eclair does not take falling damage from a fall of 30 feet or less, and difficult terrain costs her no extra movement.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: Eclair makes three attacks with her rapier, or two with her rapier and one with her claws.

action.name: Duelling Rapier
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 8} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}9 ({@damage 1d8 + 5}) piercing damage.

action.name: Claws
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 8} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}8 ({@damage 1d6 + 5}) slashing damage.

action.name: Exhibition Flourish (Recharge 5-6)
entries: Eclair makes a single rapier attack with advantage. On a hit it deals an extra 14 ({@damage 4d6}) piercing damage and the target must succeed on a {@dc 16} Constitution saving throw or be {@condition stunned} until the end of Eclair's next turn.

bonus.name: Reposition
entries: Eclair takes the {@action Dash} or {@action Disengage} action.

reaction.name: Riposte
entries: When a creature misses Eclair with a melee attack, she can make one rapier attack against it.
A competitor from across the sea, in the Royal Tournament on her own merits and tired of being treated as a novelty.
Clipped and competitive. Allergic to being fussed over. She fights clean, wins on points, and takes the ring seriously even when nobody else does.

trait.name: Plague-Wise
entries: The scout has advantage on saving throws against magical effects originating from Spellplague-warped creatures or terrain, and on ability checks made to recognise them.

trait.name: Trackless
entries: The scout leaves no tracks and cannot be tracked except by magical means.

action.name: Shortbow
entries: {@atk rw} {@hit 5} to hit, range 80/320 ft., one target. {@h}6 ({@damage 1d6 + 3}) piercing damage.

action.name: Hand Axe
entries: {@atk mw,rw} {@hit 5} to hit, reach 5 ft. or range 20/60 ft., one target. {@h}6 ({@damage 1d6 + 3}) slashing damage.

bonus.name: Fade
entries: The scout takes the {@action Hide} action. It can {@action Hide} even when only lightly obscured by natural terrain.
Walks the edges of the vale and reports what is drifting in from the barrens.

trait.name: Plague-Wise
entries: The hunter has advantage on saving throws against magical effects originating from Spellplague-warped creatures or terrain.

trait.name: Marked Quarry
entries: At the start of its turn the hunter can mark one creature it can see. It deals an extra 4 ({@damage 1d8}) damage to that creature with weapon attacks, and has advantage on checks to track it. The mark lasts until the hunter marks another creature.

trait.name: Trackless
entries: The hunter leaves no tracks and cannot be tracked except by magical means.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The hunter makes two attacks.

action.name: Longbow
entries: {@atk rw} {@hit 5} to hit, range 150/600 ft., one target. {@h}7 ({@damage 1d8 + 3}) piercing damage.

action.name: Cleansing Spear
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 5} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}6 ({@damage 1d6 + 3}) piercing damage, plus 5 ({@damage 2d4}) radiant damage if the target is an aberration or a Spellplague-warped creature.

bonus.name: Fade
entries: The hunter takes the {@action Hide} or {@action Disengage} action.
Kills the warped things that come down out of the barrens, and has been doing it long enough to have opinions about mages.

trait.name: Unsteady Channel
entries: When the apprentice rolls a 1 on an attack roll with a spell or fails a Constitution save to maintain concentration, the nearest creature within 10 feet of it takes 2 ({@damage 1d4}) force damage from the backwash.

spellcasting.name: Spellcasting
headerEntries: The apprentice is a 3rd-level spellcaster. Its spellcasting ability is Intelligence (spell save {@dc 12}, {@hit 4} to hit with spell attacks). It has the following spells prepared:

action.name: Quarterstaff
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 1} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}2 ({@damage 1d6 - 1}) bludgeoning damage.
Two or three years into a lineage that takes decades. Dangerous mostly by accident.

trait.name: Warded Focus
entries: The journeyman has advantage on Constitution saving throws made to maintain concentration on a spell.

spellcasting.name: Spellcasting
headerEntries: The journeyman is a 7th-level spellcaster. Its spellcasting ability is Intelligence (spell save {@dc 14}, {@hit 6} to hit with spell attacks). It has the following spells prepared:

action.name: Quarterstaff
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 2} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}3 ({@damage 1d6}) bludgeoning damage.
Trusted with work of their own and with apprentices to lose sleep over.

trait.name: Warded Focus
entries: The master has advantage on Constitution saving throws made to maintain concentration on a spell.

trait.name: Plague-Tempered
entries: The master has resistance to damage from spells and to damage dealt by Spellplague-warped creatures.

spellcasting.name: Spellcasting
headerEntries: The master is a 12th-level spellcaster. Its spellcasting ability is Intelligence (spell save {@dc 16}, {@hit 8} to hit with spell attacks). It has the following spells prepared:

action.name: Rune Staff
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 3} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}3 ({@damage 1d6}) bludgeoning damage plus 10 ({@damage 3d6}) force damage.

reaction.name: Turn the Working
entries: When a creature the master can see within 60 feet casts a spell of 5th level or lower, the master can expend a spell slot of the same level or higher to cast {@spell counterspell} in response. On a success the master gains temporary hit points equal to five times the spell's level.
Holds a lineage of spellcraft and the authority that comes with it. Teaches, judges, and is rarely the one who travels.

trait.name: Warded Focus
entries: The mage-adept has advantage on Constitution saving throws made to maintain concentration on a spell.

trait.name: Plague-Tempered
entries: The mage-adept has resistance to damage from spells and to damage dealt by Spellplague-warped creatures.

trait.name: Hold the Weave
entries: If the mage-adept fails a saving throw, it can choose to succeed instead. It can use this trait three times per day.

trait.name: Reads the Field
entries: The mage-adept knows the school and level of any spell cast within 120 feet of it, and the direction of its caster.

spellcasting.name: Spellcasting
headerEntries: The mage-adept is a 17th-level spellcaster. Its spellcasting ability is Intelligence (spell save {@dc 18}, {@hit 10} to hit with spell attacks). It has the following spells prepared:

action.name: Adept's Staff
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 4} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}4 ({@damage 1d6 + 1}) bludgeoning damage plus 18 ({@damage 4d8}) force damage.

action.name: Unmake (Recharge 5-6)
entries: The mage-adept picks apart a working or a creature in a 30-foot cone. Each creature in the area must make a {@dc 18} Constitution saving throw, taking 45 ({@damage 10d8}) force damage on a failed save, or half as much on a successful one. Ongoing spells of 6th level or lower in the area end.

reaction.name: Turn the Working
entries: When a creature the mage-adept can see within 60 feet casts a spell, the mage-adept can expend a spell slot of the same level or higher to cast {@spell counterspell} in response.
The top of an Oss'kai spellcraft lineage. There are very few, they are known by name across the continent, and they answer to no crown.

trait.name: Steady Hands
entries: The apprentice has advantage on Wisdom ({@skill Medicine}) checks made to stabilise a creature at 0 hit points.

spellcasting.name: Spellcasting
headerEntries: The apprentice is a 3rd-level spellcaster. Its spellcasting ability is Wisdom (spell save {@dc 12}, {@hit 4} to hit with spell attacks). It has the following spells prepared:

action.name: Quarterstaff
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 2} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}3 ({@damage 1d6}) bludgeoning damage.
Carries the kit, holds the light, and is allowed to close small wounds unsupervised.

trait.name: Plague-Wise
entries: The journeyman has advantage on ability checks and saving throws made to identify, treat, or resist the effects of Spellplague exposure.

spellcasting.name: Spellcasting
headerEntries: The journeyman is a 7th-level spellcaster. Its spellcasting ability is Wisdom (spell save {@dc 14}, {@hit 6} to hit with spell attacks). It has the following spells prepared:

action.name: Quarterstaff
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 2} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}3 ({@damage 1d6}) bludgeoning damage.

bonus.name: Field Triage
entries: The journeyman touches a creature that has 0 hit points. That creature becomes stable and regains 1 hit point.
Runs a ward or a caravan's health alone and decides who gets treated first.

trait.name: Plague-Wise
entries: The master has advantage on ability checks and saving throws made to identify, treat, or resist the effects of Spellplague exposure.

trait.name: Hands That Do Not Shake
entries: The master has advantage on Constitution saving throws made to maintain concentration on a spell, and its healing spells restore the maximum possible amount when cast on a creature at 0 hit points.

spellcasting.name: Spellcasting
headerEntries: The master is a 12th-level spellcaster. Its spellcasting ability is Wisdom (spell save {@dc 16}, {@hit 8} to hit with spell attacks). It has the following spells prepared:

action.name: Rune Staff
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 3} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}3 ({@damage 1d6}) bludgeoning damage plus 7 ({@damage 2d6}) radiant damage.

action.name: Cleansing Word (Recharge 5-6)
entries: Each creature of the master's choice within 30 feet regains 18 ({@dice 4d8}) hit points and is freed of one of the following: the {@condition blinded}, {@condition deafened}, {@condition paralyzed}, or {@condition poisoned} condition, or one disease.

reaction.name: Shield the Wounded
entries: When a creature the master can see within 30 feet takes damage, the master reduces that damage by 10 ({@dice 2d8 + 1}).
Holds a healing lineage and the ward that goes with it. Treats whoever arrives, which has made enemies on every side of every line.

trait.name: Plague-Wise
entries: The healer-adept automatically knows whether a creature or a place has been touched by the Spellplague, and how recently.

trait.name: Hold the Weave
entries: If the healer-adept fails a saving throw, it can choose to succeed instead. It can use this trait three times per day.

trait.name: Aura of Mending
entries: At the start of each of the healer-adept's turns, each ally within 30 feet regains 5 hit points.

spellcasting.name: Spellcasting
headerEntries: The healer-adept is a 17th-level spellcaster. Its spellcasting ability is Wisdom (spell save {@dc 19}, {@hit 11} to hit with spell attacks). It has the following spells prepared:

action.name: Adept's Staff
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 4} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}4 ({@damage 1d6 + 1}) bludgeoning damage plus 18 ({@damage 4d8}) radiant damage.

action.name: Unmaking Sickness (Recharge 5-6)
entries: The healer-adept strips harm out of a 30-foot radius. Each creature of its choice in the area regains 36 ({@dice 8d8}) hit points, ends all diseases and poisons affecting it, and is freed of the {@condition blinded}, {@condition deafened}, {@condition paralyzed}, and {@condition stunned} conditions.

reaction.name: Refuse the Wound
entries: When a creature the healer-adept can see within 60 feet would drop to 0 hit points, it instead drops to 1 hit point.
The top of an Oss'kai healing lineage. Will not be conscripted, will not choose a side, and has buried enough people on both to mean it.

trait.name: Keeper of the House
entries: Nessa has advantage on Initiative rolls. She can't be surprised while the signal lantern is lit and she can see it.

trait.name: Opportunist
entries: Once per turn, Nessa deals an extra 7 ({@damage 2d6}) damage when she hits a target with a weapon attack and has advantage on the attack roll, or when the target is within 5 feet of an ally of hers that isn't {@condition incapacitated}.

trait.name: The Arrangement
entries: While Nessa is within 5 feet of a hostage, has a hand on that hostage, and isn't {@condition incapacitated}, any creature that attacks her or targets her with a spell must first succeed on a {@dc 13} Wisdom saving throw or lose that action. This is leverage rather than magic. The effect ends if a hostage is freed or moved beyond her reach, or if she is {@condition grappled}, {@condition restrained}, or {@condition prone}.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: Nessa makes two attacks, in any combination.

action.name: Shortsword
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 5} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}6 ({@damage 1d6 + 3}) piercing damage.

action.name: Hand Crossbow
entries: {@atk rw} {@hit 5} to hit, range 30/120 ft., one target. {@h}6 ({@damage 1d6 + 3}) piercing damage.

action.name: Signal (1/Encounter)
entries: Nessa reaches the gable lantern or blows the whistle on her belt. The stable crew (three {@creature Pyreborn Bravo|WildsOfOsse|bravos}) arrives at the start of the third round after this. This action is prevented by a {@spell silence} effect, by dropping or restraining her first, or if the party has already taken the lantern.

bonus.name: Bark Orders
entries: One allied Pyreborn within 30 feet of Nessa that can hear her uses its reaction to make one weapon attack.

reaction.name: Parry
entries: Nessa adds 2 to her AC against one melee attack that would hit her. To do so, she must see the attacker and be wielding a melee weapon.
Crew boss at the Drover's Rest. She keeps a kettle on, keeps a ledger of the days, and calls her hostages "missus" without a trace of irony. She never raises her voice and never threatens twice.

Round one is the hostage or the signal, never damage. She fights to make leaving expensive rather than to win. At half hit points, or once the hostages are clear of her, she offers terms and means them. She is an employee, not a believer, and she is worth far more captured than killed.

trait.name: Quarter Tough
entries: The bravo has advantage on attack rolls against a creature if at least one other Pyreborn is within 5 feet of the creature and that Pyreborn isn't {@condition incapacitated}.

trait.name: Raise the Cry
entries: The first time the bravo takes damage or clearly sees an intruder, if it can shout and isn't in an area of magical silence, the Alarm Clock advances one tick. Dropping a sentry silently is worth a full tick.

action.name: Cudgel
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 4} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}5 ({@damage 1d6 + 2}) bludgeoning damage. If the target has no allies within 5 feet of it, it has disadvantage on its next ability check.

action.name: Light Crossbow
entries: {@atk rw} {@hit 4} to hit, range 80/320 ft., one target. {@h}6 ({@damage 1d8 + 2}) piercing damage.

action.name: Firepot (Hatch Guard Only, 2 Uses)
entries: The bravo hurls a clay firepot at a point it can see within 20 feet (60 feet at long range). Each creature within 10 feet of that point must make a {@dc 12} Dexterity saving throw, taking 7 ({@damage 2d6}) fire damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one. Flammable objects in the area that aren't being worn or carried catch fire.
Quarter toughs on the Pyreborn payroll. They burn buildings, they collect, and they sit on the people the gang needs kept.
Morale: they work here. Two of six break and run once three of them are down, or once their crew boss is taken. Do not play them to the last hit point.

trait.name: Keen Hearing and Smell
entries: The dog has advantage on Wisdom ({@skill Perception}) checks that rely on hearing or smell.

trait.name: Chained and Hungry
entries: Scarred, badly fed, and the single most likely thing to catch the party. Settling the dog without killing it removes one tick from the Alarm Clock. Killing it costs one.

trait.name: What It Knows
entries: Under {@spell speak with animals}, or on a successful {@dc 12} Wisdom ({@skill Animal Handling}) check, the dog conveys how many people are in the house, that one of them feeds it and the rest kick it, and that the small one cries under the floor.

action.name: Bite
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 4} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}5 ({@damage 1d6 + 2}) piercing damage. If the target is a creature, it must succeed on a {@dc 11} Strength saving throw or be knocked {@condition prone}.
It barks before it bites. The bark is the problem.

trait.name: Running with the Crest
entries: The initiate has advantage on saving throws against being {@condition frightened} while at least two other Pyreborn it can see are within 30 feet of it.

action.name: Club
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 3} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}3 ({@damage 1d6}) bludgeoning damage.

action.name: Sling
entries: {@atk rw} {@hit 3} to hit, range 30/120 ft., one target. {@h}3 ({@damage 1d4 + 1}) bludgeoning damage.
Newest on the crest. Runs messages, holds corners, and throws the first stone so someone else does not have to.

trait.name: Pack Bully
entries: The thug has advantage on attack rolls against a creature if at least one ally of the thug is within 5 feet of the creature and the ally isn't {@condition incapacitated}.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The thug makes two melee attacks.

action.name: Cudgel
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 4} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}5 ({@damage 1d6 + 2}) bludgeoning damage.

action.name: Heavy Crossbow
entries: {@atk rw} {@hit 3} to hit, range 100/400 ft., one target. {@h}6 ({@damage 1d10 + 1}) piercing damage.
The standing body of the gang. Collects, evicts, and stands behind whoever is doing the talking.

trait.name: Pack Bully
entries: The enforcer has advantage on attack rolls against a creature if at least one ally of the enforcer is within 5 feet of the creature and the ally isn't {@condition incapacitated}.

trait.name: Hard to Move
entries: The enforcer has advantage on saving throws and ability checks made to avoid being {@condition grappled}, {@condition restrained}, or knocked {@condition prone}.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The enforcer makes two melee attacks.

action.name: Iron-Shod Maul
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 5} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}9 ({@damage 2d6 + 3}) bludgeoning damage, and if the target is Large or smaller it must succeed on a {@dc 13} Strength saving throw or be pushed 10 feet away.

action.name: Firepot (2/Day)
entries: The enforcer hurls a clay firepot at a point it can see within 20 feet (60 feet at long range). Each creature within 10 feet of that point must make a {@dc 13} Dexterity saving throw, taking 10 ({@damage 3d6}) fire damage on a failed save, or half as much on a successful one. Flammable objects in the area that aren't being worn or carried catch fire.

reaction.name: Step In
entries: When a creature the enforcer can see attacks a Pyreborn within 5 feet of the enforcer, the enforcer can make that attack target the enforcer instead.
The gang's answer to a door that will not open and a debtor who will not pay.

trait.name: Crest Discipline
entries: Allied Pyreborn within 30 feet of the lieutenant that can see or hear it have advantage on saving throws against being {@condition frightened} and add 2 to their damage rolls with weapon attacks.

trait.name: Read the Room
entries: The lieutenant has advantage on Wisdom ({@skill Insight}) checks and on Initiative rolls.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The lieutenant makes two melee attacks, or two attacks with its hand crossbow.

action.name: Crest-Marked Axe
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 6} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}8 ({@damage 1d8 + 4}) slashing damage, plus 7 ({@damage 2d6}) damage if the lieutenant has advantage on the attack roll.

action.name: Hand Crossbow
entries: {@atk rw} {@hit 5} to hit, range 30/120 ft., one target. {@h}6 ({@damage 1d6 + 3}) piercing damage.

bonus.name: Send Them In
entries: One allied Pyreborn within 30 feet that can hear the lieutenant uses its reaction to move up to its speed or make one weapon attack.

reaction.name: Someone Else's Turn
entries: When the lieutenant is hit by an attack and an allied Pyreborn is within 5 feet of it, the lieutenant can swap places with that ally. The ally becomes the target of the attack and takes the damage.
Runs a district for the gang. Answers upward to someone whose name is never said on the street.

trait.name: Wears the Crest Openly
entries: Bram carries a crescent moon inside a sun on both armour and weapon. Allied Pyreborn within 30 feet of him that can see him have advantage on saving throws against being {@condition frightened}, and they add 2 to their damage rolls with weapon attacks.

trait.name: Play to the Crowd
entries: At the start of each of Bram's turns, if at least three creatures that are not his allies can see him, he gains 5 temporary hit points.

trait.name: Brute
entries: A melee weapon deals one extra die of its damage when Bram hits with it (included below).

action.name: Multiattack
entries: Bram makes two attacks with his crested axe, or three if he has taken damage since the end of his last turn.

action.name: Crested Axe
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 7} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}13 ({@damage 2d8 + 4}) slashing damage.

action.name: Boot
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 7} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}7 ({@damage 1d6 + 4}) bludgeoning damage, and the target must succeed on a {@dc 15} Strength saving throw or be knocked {@condition prone}.

action.name: Make an Example (Recharge 5-6)
entries: Bram roars a challenge at one creature he can see within 30 feet. The target must make a {@dc 13} Wisdom saving throw. On a failure it is {@condition frightened} of Bram for 1 minute and must use its action on its turn to move toward him if it can. It repeats the save at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on a success.

bonus.name: Drive Them Forward
entries: Two allied Pyreborn within 30 feet that can hear Bram each use their reaction to move up to their speed or make one weapon attack.

reaction.name: Hold the Corner
entries: When an ally within 5 feet of Bram is hit by an attack, Bram can reduce the damage by 5 ({@dice 1d10}).
Holds a quarter for the Pyreborn by being the loudest and hardest thing in it. He wears his employer's crest without knowing what it means.
He is not subtle and does not want to be. Taken away from his crew he is a far smaller problem, which is the fight worth setting up.

trait.name: Voice in the Crowd
entries: The agitator has advantage on Charisma checks made to sway a crowd of five or more creatures.

action.name: Dagger
entries: {@atk mw,rw} {@hit 4} to hit, reach 5 ft. or range 20/60 ft., one target. {@h}4 ({@damage 1d4 + 2}) piercing damage.

action.name: Work the Crowd
entries: The agitator calls out to bystanders within 60 feet. Each creature of the agitator's choice in that area that can hear it must succeed on a {@dc 12} Wisdom saving throw or move up to its speed toward a place, person, or door the agitator names.

bonus.name: Slip the Line
entries: The agitator takes the {@action Disengage} or {@action Hide} action.
Carries the message into rooms and markets. Never armed with anything that would be hard to explain.

trait.name: Cell Discipline
entries: The organizer knows only what it needs to. It has advantage on Charisma ({@skill Deception}) checks made to conceal the structure or membership of its cell, and magic that would compel it to name a superior reveals only a cover identity.

trait.name: Sapper's Eye
entries: The organizer has advantage on Intelligence ({@skill Investigation}) checks to find the weak point of a structure, and it deals double damage to objects and structures.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The organizer makes two attacks.

action.name: Short Sword
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 5} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}6 ({@damage 1d6 + 3}) piercing damage.

action.name: Alchemical Charge (2/Day)
entries: The organizer sets or throws a charge at a point within 30 feet. It detonates immediately, or at the start of a later round the organizer chooses. Each creature within 10 feet of the point must make a {@dc 13} Dexterity saving throw, taking 14 ({@damage 4d6}) fire damage on a failed save, or half as much on a successful one. An unattended object or structure in the area takes double damage.
Builds the cell, keeps the lists in its head, and brings down what needs bringing down without a crowd watching.

trait.name: Cell Discipline
entries: The supervisor has advantage on Charisma ({@skill Deception}) checks made to conceal the structure or membership of its cell, and magic that would compel it to name a superior reveals only a cover identity.

trait.name: Evasion
entries: If the supervisor is subjected to an effect that allows a Dexterity save for half damage, it instead takes no damage on a success and half damage on a failure.

trait.name: Contingency Planned
entries: The supervisor has advantage on Initiative rolls, and it cannot be surprised while conscious in a location it chose.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The supervisor makes two attacks.

action.name: Rapier
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 6} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}8 ({@damage 1d8 + 4}) piercing damage, plus 10 ({@damage 3d6}) damage if the supervisor has advantage on the attack roll or an ally is within 5 feet of the target.

action.name: Hand Crossbow
entries: {@atk rw} {@hit 6} to hit, range 30/120 ft., one target. {@h}7 ({@damage 1d6 + 4}) piercing damage.

action.name: Give the Word
entries: Up to three allies within 60 feet that can see or hear the supervisor each use their reaction to move up to their speed, make one weapon attack, or take the {@action Hide} action.

bonus.name: Vanish
entries: The supervisor takes the {@action Disengage} or {@action Hide} action. It can {@action Hide} even when only lightly obscured by a crowd.

reaction.name: Not Tonight
entries: When the supervisor is hit by an attack it can see, it halves the damage and moves up to half its speed without provoking opportunity attacks.
Runs a city cell and answers to one person nobody in the cell has met. Fights only long enough to leave with the cell intact.

trait.name: Two Registers
entries: Ilna can switch between her stage manner and her working manner as a free action. While in her stage manner she has advantage on Charisma checks made in front of an audience. While in her working manner she has advantage on Dexterity ({@skill Stealth}) checks and on checks made to pass unnoticed.

trait.name: Discipline over Mob
entries: Allies within 30 feet that can hear Ilna have advantage on saving throws against being {@condition charmed} or {@condition frightened}.

trait.name: Nothing Written Down
entries: Ilna keeps no records. Divination and mind-reading magic used against her reveals only what she has rehearsed, unless the caster succeeds on a {@dc 15} Charisma check contested by her {@skill Deception}.

spellcasting.name: Spellcasting
headerEntries: Ilna is a 7th-level spellcaster. Its spellcasting ability is Charisma (spell save {@dc 15}, {@hit 7} to hit with spell attacks). It has the following spells prepared:

action.name: Multiattack
entries: Ilna makes two attacks with her dagger, or casts a cantrip and makes one attack.

action.name: Dagger
entries: {@atk mw,rw} {@hit 6} to hit, reach 5 ft. or range 20/60 ft., one target. {@h}6 ({@damage 1d4 + 4}) piercing damage.

action.name: Captivating Performance (Recharge 5-6)
entries: Ilna sings, and every creature of her choice within 60 feet that can hear her must succeed on a {@dc 15} Wisdom saving throw or be {@condition charmed} for 1 minute. A charmed creature is {@condition incapacitated} and has a speed of 0 while it listens. The effect ends for a creature if it takes damage or if someone else uses an action to shake it free.

bonus.name: Misdirect
entries: Ilna takes the {@action Hide} action, or causes one creature she can see within 30 feet to look somewhere she chooses.

reaction.name: Cutting Word
entries: When a creature Ilna can see within 60 feet makes an attack roll, ability check, or damage roll, Ilna subtracts 6 ({@dice 1d10 + 1}) from the roll.
A performer who runs a city cell out of the room she is performing in. Onstage she is warm, loud, and impossible to look away from. Off it she is quiet and wastes nothing.
She fights to leave, not to win, and she will spend a subordinate's life to do it without changing expression.

trap.name: Sabotaged Shield Rune
entries: A shield rune is a defensive working etched into a tablet, a bracer, or a weapon haft, and it is common enough in Varenthal that nobody looks twice at one. A sabotaged rune has had a single stroke altered so that the ward inverts on discharge, turning the protection inward and outward at once. The alteration is deliberate, small, and very hard to see.

entries.name: Trigger
entries: The rune discharges when its bearer would take damage, which is what it is supposed to do. Nothing happens until then.

entries.name: Effect
entries: Instead of absorbing the blow, the rune releases it. The bearer takes 21 ({@dice 6d6}) force damage and must succeed on a {@dc 15} Constitution saving throw or be knocked {@condition prone} and {@condition stunned} until the end of its next turn.
Each other creature within 10 feet of the bearer must make a {@dc 15} Dexterity saving throw, taking 10 ({@dice 3d6}) force damage on a failed save, or half as much on a successful one.
The rune is destroyed, and any other rune worn by the bearer has a 50 percent chance of being destroyed with it.

entries.name: Countermeasures
entries: A creature that inspects the rune can spot the altered stroke with a successful {@dc 18} Intelligence ({@skill Arcana}) check, or {@dc 15} if the creature is proficient with the tools used to cut runes. {@spell Detect magic} shows an abjuration and nothing wrong with it. {@spell Identify} reveals the sabotage automatically.
A creature with rune-cutting tools can neutralise a spotted sabotage over 10 minutes with a successful {@dc 15} check using those tools. On a failed check by 5 or more, the rune discharges as above.
A sabotaged rune is worth 3,200 XP if the party disarms one before it fires, or if they survive the one that does.

item.name: Sun and Moon Signet Ring
entries: A heavy signet ring bearing a crescent moon set inside a sun. The mark is an old warrior-clan device rather than a granted heraldic arms, which means it predates the family's nobility and is not registered anywhere a herald would look.
Pressed into wax, the seal is recognised on sight by anyone who deals with the family's business, and by a number of people who would rather not admit they recognise it.
Wearing it openly in the wrong quarter is a statement. Wearing it openly in the right quarter is a threat.

item.name: Split Ring, Sun Half
entries: One half of a signet ring that was cut down the middle and worn by two people. This half carries the sun, with the cut edge crossing where the crescent would sit.
Alone it seals nothing. Pressed into wax beside its other half, the two halves make one complete mark and the seam is visible in the impression.
A ring cut in half is not a gift. It is a promise that somebody intended to keep.

item.name: Split Ring, Moon Half
entries: One half of a signet ring that was cut down the middle and worn by two people. This half carries the crescent, with the cut edge running through the sun's rays.
Alone it seals nothing. Pressed into wax beside its other half, the two halves make one complete mark and the seam is visible in the impression.
Whoever holds this half was meant to be found by whoever holds the other.

item.name: Father Barichello's Rosary
entries: A worn string of wooden beads with a small crucifix, from a faith nobody on this continent has heard of. The beads are smooth at the places a thumb has rested for decades.
It holds no magic. It is a focus for a man who does not need one, and a proof of identity to the handful of people who would know it on sight.
A creature that carries it and shares Barichello's faith can use it as a holy symbol and as a spellcasting focus.

item.name: Father Barichello's Bible
entries: A thick, water-marked volume in a language spoken nowhere in Osse, bound in cracked leather and annotated in three different hands across the margins. The annotations argue with each other.
The book is not magical, but it is the only copy of its scripture on the continent, and its owner's notes record a lifetime of reading texts other men of his faith would have burned.
A creature that spends 1 hour studying it alongside a religious, philosophical, or blasphemous text has advantage on the next Intelligence ({@skill Religion}) check it makes concerning that text.

item.name: Blank Rune Tablet
entries: A palm-sized slate of fired clay banded in soft iron, prepared to hold a rune and holding none. Rune shops sell them by the crate and guilds account for them carefully, because a blank tablet in the wrong hands is the first half of a forgery.
A creature proficient with rune-cutting tools can inscribe a prepared rune onto a blank tablet over 1 hour of uninterrupted work. A tablet holds one rune and is consumed when that rune discharges.
An uninscribed tablet is worth 25 gp. An inscribed one is worth whatever the buyer is afraid of.
